code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low O₂ saturation, low pO₂), anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, monocytosis, and abnormal differential counts. There is also mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine), hypoglycemia, elevated ferritin, and prolonged INR. These findings suggest severe systemic illness, possibly sepsis or multi-organ dysfunction, and require urgent clinical evaluation and intervention.
